brief:
Arab citizens of Israel turned out in high numbers for Knesset elections, the Ma'an news agency reported, a shift that could reshape the parliamentary arithmetic ahead. Historically low Arab participation has allowed right-wing blocs to dominate Israeli politics; increased Arab engagement this cycle threatens to dilute that advantage.

The higher turnout raised questions about whether Netanyahu's coalition strategy, built on assumptions of Arab voter apathy, remains viable. Election observers noted the surge reflects Arab community mobilization in response to policies affecting Palestinian citizens of Israel.

title: Arab voters surge in Israeli election, testing Netanyahu's political calculus
